Jharkhand men 108 enbulens karmiyon ki hartal jari, svasthy mantri irphan ansari bole, enbulens band hone se koee trahimam nahin, marijon ka kiraya sarkar degi.
RIMS jamin ghotale men ACB ka bara ekshan, 7 adhikariyon ki giraphtari ke bad ranchi se jamshedpur tak kaee thikanon par chhapemari, aham dastavej aur ilektronik gaijets jabta.
